def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix island label variants (strip leading/trailing spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df_clean = clean(df)
    result = df_clean.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return result
